purpose: Use the complete attested candidate inventory to measure and improve dynamic reconstruction instead of treating low-frequency material as a deletion queue.

R0.name: invalid_or_quarantined
R0.description: Explicitly rejected invalid material or a source reading with alignment failure.

R1.name: unreachable_residual
R1.description: No reading can be reconstructed from shorter attested components.

R2.name: partially_reachable
R2.description: Some readings are reconstructable and some are not.

R3.name: search_or_ambiguity_risk
R3.description: All readings are structurally reachable but decomposition cost or ambiguity exceeds the reliable threshold.

R4.name: dynamic_recoverable
R4.description: All readings are structurally reachable within the reliable search threshold and no static exception applies.

R5.name: static_foundation_or_evidence_cache
R5.description: Foundational characters, protected categories, approved static items or utility-selected caches.
